test_descriptions.video_title: AW11 MR2 Engine Teardown - Finding the Problem
test_descriptions.description: The Goblin MR2 has been losing compression on cylinder 4. Time to tear down the 4AGE and see what's broken. Ian walks through the disassembly process.

test_descriptions.video_title: Three Honda Fits Battle at Rallycross - Fit Off Round 4
test_descriptions.description: We brought three Honda Fits to the dirt for another Fit Off showdown. Fitty Cent takes on two rival GD3s in rallycross competition. Cones were destroyed, times were compared, and one Fit proved superior.

test_descriptions.video_title: Can We Fix the Celica Before the Championship Race?
test_descriptions.description: Dale's Dragon (RA21 Celica with 18RG motor) broke a spindle two weeks before the season finale. Ryan and Ian race against time to source parts and get it race-ready.

test_descriptions.video_title: MGB GT First Rallycross Run
test_descriptions.description: The MGB GT with Toyota motor swap hits the dirt for its maiden rallycross run. Richard takes it through tech, walks, and runs.

test_descriptions.video_title: Junkyard Honda Fit Rescue - Is It Worth Saving?
test_descriptions.description: We found another GD3 Honda Fit at a local junkyard for $800. It's rough, but it has potential. Ian evaluates whether this Fit can be saved or if it's parts car material.

test_descriptions.video_title: Autocross Nationals - FSP Class Battle
test_descriptions.description: Ian takes Fitty Cent to SCCA Solo Nationals in Lincoln, NE to compete in FSP class against heavily modified Rabbits, Civics, and other hot hatches.

test_descriptions.video_title: Installing Coilovers on the Goblin MR2
test_descriptions.description: Quick install video showing Ian swapping the stock suspension for coilovers on the AW11 MR2. No talking, just wrenching and time-lapse.

test_descriptions.video_title: Why the Honda Fit is Better Than a Miata for Rallycross
test_descriptions.description: Ian makes the case for why the Honda Fit (GE8/GD3) is the superior grassroots rallycross platform compared to the Miata. Hot take with data from 2 seasons of racing.

test_descriptions.video_title: Lake Garnett Grand Prix Revival 2025 - Vintage Racing Chaos
test_descriptions.description: OIO brings Dale's Dragon Celica and the MGB GT to Lake Garnett for vintage racing. Beautiful cars, close racing, and questionable reliability. Church of Combustion sermon mode.

test_descriptions.video_title: Budget Brake Upgrade - Honda Fit DIY
test_descriptions.description: How to upgrade your Honda Fit brakes on a budget using junkyard parts and basic tools. Ian shows the step-by-step process.

test_descriptions.video_title: MR2 vs Fit - Slowest Drag Race Ever
test_descriptions.description: The Goblin MR2 and Fitty Cent face off in a drag race. Both are slow. Both are loud. Only one can win (barely).

test_descriptions.video_title: Saying Goodbye to the 1982 Cressida Wagon
test_descriptions.description: After two seasons of rallycross abuse, the Cressida wagon is being retired. A look back at the best moments and worst failures.

test_descriptions.video_title: Starlet Gets a 4AGE Swap - Budget JDM Build
test_descriptions.description: Ryan starts the 4AGE engine swap into the 1983 Starlet. This budget JDM build is destined for rallycross once it's running.

test_descriptions.video_title: Rallycross in the Rain - KCRSCCA Event Recap
test_descriptions.description: Wet, muddy, and chaotic. The Kansas City Region SCCA rallycross in the rain with the Goblin MR2 and Fitty Cent. Both cars survived (barely).

test_descriptions.video_title: Why We Race Cheap Old Cars
test_descriptions.description: Ian talks about why OIO focuses on budget builds, junkyard finds, and vintage Japanese cars instead of modern performance machines.

test_descriptions.video_title: ST205 Celica GT-Four Track Day Debut
test_descriptions.description: Richard brings the ST205 Celica GT-Four (3SGTE, AWD) to its first track day. Turbocharged JDM legend meets midwest road course.

test_descriptions.video_title: Fitting 15x8 Wheels on a Stock Honda Fit
test_descriptions.description: Quick video showing the wheel fitment test on Fitty Cent. Testing how wide we can go on the stock GE8 Fit body without fender work.

test_descriptions.video_title: Shop Tour - Where OIO Builds Race Cars
test_descriptions.description: Tour of the OIO shop where all the builds happen. See the tools, the lift, the parts pile, and the current projects in progress.

test_descriptions.video_title: Pre-Race Prep - What We Do Before Every Event
test_descriptions.description: Ian walks through the pre-race checklist for the Goblin MR2. Fluids, tire pressure, safety gear, spares kit. The boring but critical stuff.

test_descriptions.video_title: The Celica Lives - First Start After Engine Build
test_descriptions.description: After months of teardown and rebuild, Dale's Dragon Celica fires up for the first time. The 18RG motor is alive. Now it's time to race.
